Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at nft: the pair (nft, jrp) comes first; its second item is jrp, so the next pair is the one whose first item is rp: (rp, jrp). Its second item is jrp, but jrp never appears as a first item - so jrp is the dangling end of the chain.
